'''Leito Retinol''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the managing director of [[Karflo Corporation/Legends|Karflo Corporation's]] operations on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. Little was known of his background, save that he once worked for [[Dynamic Synergetics, Inc.]] Retinol has extensive knowledge of [[Hyperbaride/Legends|hyperbaride]] extraction and cracking.
